data.text:
Currently underway in the Philippines as of May 6, 2026, is Exercise Balikatan 2026 
(BK26, the 41st iteration)

It is explicitly described across official U.S., Philippine, and allied sources as the largest and most expansive iteration ever held. 

• April 20 to May 8, 2026 (still active right now, with high-intensity live-fire phases occurring in the final week). 
Scale and Participants
•  17,000 total troops (roughly 10,000+ U.S., plus substantial Philippine Armed Forces contingents and the rest from allies). 
•  Seven nations: Philippines (host/AFP), United States, Japan (1,400 troops — first time as full active participant, not just observer), Australia, Canada, France, and New Zealand. 
•  This marks the biggest multinational footprint in Balikatan history and the 75th anniversary of the U.S.-Philippines Mutual Defense Treaty.

data.text:
UPDATE: Mahigit 600 pamilya o katumbas ng mahigit 1,800 residente ang nawalan ng bahay sa Task Force Alpha na sunog sa Lower Brgy. San Antonio, Parañaque City.

Ayon kay City Marshal FSUPT Liher Barrios, tinatayang mahigit 300 kabahayan ang naabo at nasa P900-libo ang pinsala sa mga ari-arian.

May mga bahay aniya na gawa sa light materials kaya mabilis na kumalat ang apoy.

Halos buong BFP sa Metro Manila, sabi ni Barrios, ang natulong-tulong para apulahin ang sunog.

Mahigit 6 oras tinupok ng apoy ang residential area na nababalot pa rin ng makapal na usok sa mga oras na ito.

Binuksan na ang San Antonio Elementary School at ilang evacuation center sa lugar para sa mga apektado. | RH 15 @JecelleRicafort, DZRH News
